grounds.name: College Ground, Cheltenham College
grounds.role: Hosts the Cheltenham Cricket Festival each summer
getting_there: About half a mile from the Promenade, on the south side of the town.
About 1.2 miles from Cheltenham Spa railway station, roughly a 25-minute walk.
Gloucestershire Cricket publishes parking and travel information for each festival, so check its festival page before you go.

grounds.name: Bristol County Ground (Seat Unique Stadium)
grounds.role: The club's main home ground, for most home matches
getting_there: About 36 miles south-west of Cheltenham as the crow flies, so allow a much longer journey than for the Cheltenham matches.
The club recommends public transport: several bus services stop within a few minutes' walk on nearby Gloucester Road, and parking near the ground is limited.
For trains from Cheltenham Spa, see our train times page.
